added.name: Taan.ai
added.long_description:
Taan builds foundation music models that do what you tell them to, when you tell them to. We're starting with music for video. Give Taan a video and it watches it, then composes an original score that follows the emotion and timing of every cut. If the scene is tense for 10 seconds and then turns happy, the music changes at that exact moment. You get back a fully mixed .mp4. Agents and apps call Taan through our API, so any video tool can add scored, synced music with one call. 

Today's music models can make catchy tracks, but you can't steer them. Ask for "violin at exactly the 11th second" and they usually skip it. We trained Taan from the ground up for control. 

We measured Taan on prompt adherence and instruction success. And against every leading model we tested, Taan was at least 4x better.  

We work with teams building video agents, ad and creative tools, micro-dramas and games. We're musicians and ML researchers. Adithya (CEO) comes from eight generations of Indian classical musicians, tours as a metal guitarist, has done music ML research since 2023, and has filed two patents on music generation architectures. Devansh (CTO) did signal-processing research at IIT Kanpur and was previously an ML engineer at American Express.
added.one_liner: the most precise & controllable foundation music models

long_description.before:
While building WeReno.com, we managed over $1B in renovations and noticed something: property owners kept coming back long after projects ended. We realized buildings have no memory, and every repair, maintenance issue, and service request starts from scratch.

So we built Handyman.ai, an AI agent that remembers your property, anticipates problems, and handles everything from maintenance to repairs.

In our first few months, we facilitated over $10M in GMV, validating the opportunity to build an AI agent for every property.
long_description.after:
WeReno helps property owners plan and execute renovations and capital projects. We combine technology with hands-on project management, contractor sourcing, and owner's representation to deliver complex projects more efficiently.

Founded in 2022 and backed by Y Combinator (W22), we've facilitated over $1B in renovations and capital projects across residential, commercial, and hospitality properties.

Our platform simplifies the entire renovation lifecycle, from initial planning and budgeting to contractor selection, procurement, project oversight, and delivery.

We're building a more transparent, efficient, and technology-driven way to improve the built world.

one_liner.before: Handyman.ai by WeReno | The AI Agent That Knows and Runs Your Property

long_description.before:
Coding agents now write more code than teams can check, making verification pipelines the new bottleneck. Graphide builds that verification, starting with CI.

Graphide CI runs faster and cheaper because we own both the hardware and the optimizations and configs that run on it, which lets us do what owning only one could not. A graph of the codebase runs only the tests each change can reach, and always-on agents tune machines, caches and test splits together, around the clock. Optionally, we also patch the tests themselves with our own libraries so they run faster. We have seen most of our customers cut CI time 80-90% compared to their existing setups.

Our PR review agent then runs the old and new code in a live environment, finding bugs and proving them by writing tests, as well as analyzing synthetic and production data through the PR before it merges. The first 150 reviews are free.

Graphide verifies the code agents write.
